search_files.name: search_files
search_files.description: Search file names and indexed text in the folders the user allowed, to find documents or files on this Mac.

system_info.name: system_info
system_info.description: Live snapshot of this Mac right now: memory (RAM) use, CPU load, storage space, uptime and the busiest processes.

look_up_online.name: look_up_online
look_up_online.description: Look something up on the internet when the answer needs current or outside facts you can't know: weather, news, prices, exchange rates, places, flights or recent events. Never for chat, jokes, advice, maths or general knowledge you can answer yourself. The user approves before anything is sent.

remember.name: remember
remember.description: Save a lasting fact or preference the user wants you to remember, such as their name for someone, a diet or a routine. Only when they ask you to remember something or clearly state a lasting preference.

fact.description: The fact as a short third-person sentence, for example: The user's sister is Ana.

add_reminder.name: add_reminder
add_reminder.description: Add a reminder to the Reminders app. The user reviews it before it is added.

due.description: Local date and time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour).

add_calendar_event.name: add_calendar_event
add_calendar_event.description: Add an event to the Calendar app. The user reviews it before it is added.

start.description: Local date and time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (24-hour).

minutes.description: How long it lasts, in minutes.

create_note.name: create_note
create_note.description: Write a new note in the Notes app. The user reviews it before it is saved.

draft_email.name: draft_email
draft_email.description: Open a new email draft in Mail for the user to review and send themselves. Never sends.

run_shortcut.name: run_shortcut
run_shortcut.description: Run one of the user's own Shortcuts by its exact name. The user approves first.

open_app.name: open_app
open_app.description: Open an app installed on this Mac.

name.description: The app's name, for example Safari or Notes.

open_link.name: open_link
open_link.description: Open a web page in the user's browser.

web_search.name: web_search
web_search.description: Search the live web. The controller requires the user's explicit online search intent.

weather.name: weather
weather.description: Current conditions and the 7-day forecast for a named place.

place.description: City or town, optionally with region or country

currency.name: currency
currency.description: Convert money using European Central Bank reference rates.

to.description: One or more ISO codes separated by commas

wikipedia.name: wikipedia
wikipedia.description: Look up an encyclopedia article summary about a person, place, thing or idea.

places.name: places
places.description: Find nearby places of one kind around a street, district or city using OpenStreetMap.

ebay_search.name: ebay_search
ebay_search.description: Search live eBay listings to compare prices of an item.

flight_search.name: flight_search
flight_search.description: Search flight offers between two airports or cities on given dates. Search only, never booking.

origin.description: IATA code like LIS, or a city name

read_mail.name: read_mail
read_mail.description: Read the user's recent email in the Mail app: newest inbox messages with sender, subject and the start of each, or ones matching a sender or subject. Read-only; to reply, use draft_email.

query.description: A sender name, address or words from the subject. Leave out for the latest mail.

limit.description: How many messages, 5 if not given.

read_calendar.name: read_calendar
read_calendar.description: See the events on the user's calendar for a day, including repeating ones. Read-only; to add an event, use add_calendar_event.

day.description: The day as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today.

read_reminders.name: read_reminders
read_reminders.description: List the user's open reminders in the Reminders app, soonest due first. Read-only; to add one, use add_reminder.

find_notes.name: find_notes
find_notes.description: Find notes in the Notes app whose title or text mentions something, and show their start.

control_music.name: control_music
control_music.description: Control music in the Music app or Spotify: say what's playing, play, pause, skip to the next track or go back. With play and a query, Music plays a matching playlist or song from the library, and Spotify plays the best match from its search.

app.description: Which app. Music if not given.

query.description: With play: a playlist, song or artist to play.

browser_tabs.name: browser_tabs
browser_tabs.description: List the user's open browser tabs (title and address) in Safari, Chrome, Brave, Edge or Arc, or only those mentioning some words. Private windows are skipped.

browser.description: Which browser. Leave out to use every allowed browser.

query.description: Words from a tab's title or address. Leave out to list every tab.

switch_tab.name: switch_tab
switch_tab.description: Bring an open browser tab to the front: the first tab whose title or address mentions the words.

browser.description: Which browser. Leave out to use every allowed browser.

query.description: Words from the tab's title or address.

read_page.name: read_page
read_page.description: Read the text of the web page showing in Safari's front window, to summarise it or answer questions about it.
